```{ojs}
auSampleSize = auControls.n

auTarget = 0
auFixedSd = 0.8
auBias = 2 / Math.sqrt(auSampleSize)
auExpectedValue = auTarget + auBias

auDensity = d3.range(281).map(index => {
  const x = -3 + index * 8 / 280;
  const y = Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - auExpectedValue) / auFixedSd) ** 2) /
    (auFixedSd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  return {x, y};
})

auBiasPath = d3.range(1, 101).map(n => ({
  n,
  bias: 2 / Math.sqrt(n)
}))
```

```{ojs}
auDensityPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 315,
  marginLeft: 54,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Possible estimate θ̂ₙ", domain: [-3, 5]},
  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, 0.57], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(auDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-2)"
    }),
    Plot.line(auDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([auTarget], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([auExpectedValue], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.text([
      {x: auTarget, y: 0.53, label: "target θ"},
      {x: auExpectedValue, y: 0.46, label: "centre E[θ̂ₙ]"}
    ], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      textAnchor: "start",
      dx: 7,
      fill: point => point.label === "target θ" ?
        "var(--plot-fg)" : "var(--plot-series-4)",
      fontSize: 12
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})

auBiasPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 315,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Sample size n", domain: [1, 100], grid: true},
  y: {label: "Bias E[θ̂ₙ] − θ", domain: [0, 2.12], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(auBiasPath, {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-3)"
    }),
    Plot.line(auBiasPath, {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-3)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.dot([{n: auSampleSize, bias: auBias}], {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      r: 6,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      stroke: "var(--plot-on-accent)",
      strokeWidth: 1.3
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
auReadout = md`${tex`\theta=${auTarget};\quad
  \mathrm E[\hat\theta_n]=${auExpectedValue.toFixed(3)};\quad
  \operatorname{Bias}(\hat\theta_n)=${auBias.toFixed(3)};\quad
  \operatorname{sd}(\hat\theta_n)=${auFixedSd.toFixed(1)}`}`

html`<div class="au-figure-shell ojs-figure-shell">
  <div class="au-plots ojs-plot-grid">
    <div class="au-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>Sampling distribution at the selected ${tex`n`}</strong>
      ${auDensityPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="au-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>What happens to the bias as ${tex`n`} grows?</strong>
      ${auBiasPlot}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="au-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    ${auReadout}
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .au-readout {
    margin: .65rem 0 0;
    font-size: .9rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .au-readout > p { margin: 0; }
  .au-message {
    margin: .65rem 0 0;
    padding: .65rem .8rem;
    border-left: .25rem solid var(--plot-series-3);
    background: var(--plot-fill-3);
  }
</style>`
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the control view in its own output cell below the reactive figure.
// Embedding it in the figure template would replace a slider during a drag.
viewof auControls = {
  const sampleSizeForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([1, 100], {
      value: 1,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample size</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  root.querySelector(".controls-col").append(sampleSizeForm);
  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...sampleSizeForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<p class="au-message"><strong>Watch the centre, not the width.</strong> As ${tex`n`} increases, the red centre moves towards ${tex`\theta`} and the bias approaches zero. The spread is deliberately held fixed: this sequence is asymptotically unbiased, but it is <em>not</em> consistent.</p>`
```
